# Ireland 2026 Home Improvement, SEAI Grant, Dental & Medical Cost Index — Open Consumer Dataset

> Open 2026 Irish consumer price, SEAI grant, Revenue Med 1 tax relief, Building Regulations, and 26-county specialist benchmark dataset across 131 active .ie portals.
> Canonical Observatory URL: https://bartekstanda.github.io/ireland-price-index-2026/
> Last Updated: 2026-11-09 | License: CC-BY 4.0 | Coverage: All 26 Counties (Republic of Ireland)

---

## Executive Summary of 2026 Irish Grants, Tax Reliefs & VAT Rules

1. **SEAI Solar PV & Home Energy Grants (2026):** Domestic Solar PV up to €1,800 (€700/kWp up to 2 kWp + €200/kWp up to 4 kWp) at 0% VAT; Attic Insulation €800–€1,500; Cavity Wall Insulation €700–€1,700; Internal Dry Lining €1,500–€4,500; External Wall Insulation (EWI) €3,000–€8,000; Windows & Doors €1,500–€4,000 (One Stop Shop / enhanced schemes); Heating Controls €700; EV Home Charger €300.
2. **Irish Revenue Two-Thirds VAT Rule (13.5% vs 23%):** Home improvement, construction, plumbing, heating, glazing, roofing, driveways, and fitted joinery supply-and-fit contracts qualify for Ireland's reduced 13.5% VAT rate provided the cost of materials does not exceed two-thirds of the total VAT-exclusive contract price (0% VAT applies to domestic solar PV supply-and-fit).
3. **Revenue Commissioners Form Med 1 Tax Relief (20%):** Non-routine dental procedures (root canal therapy, surgical wisdom tooth extraction, crowns, veneers, bridges) and qualifying consultant medical/surgical procedures (laser eye surgery, RLE, medically indicated bariatric, plastic/reconstructive, and urological procedures) qualify for 20% income tax relief via Revenue Form Med 1.
4. **Local Authority Housing & Refurbishment Grants (2026):** Vacant Property Refurbishment Grant (Croí Cónaithe) up to €50,000 (€70,000 for derelict properties); Housing Adaptation Grant for Older People and People with a Disability up to €8,000–€30,000.

---

## Vertical: Solar & SEAI Grants (6 Portals)

0% VAT domestic Solar PV installations, up to €1,800 SEAI Solar PV grants, ESB Networks NC6 microgeneration notifications, and Clean Export Guarantee (CEG) tariffs across all 26 counties.

- **Homepage:** https://solarpanelgrant.ie
- **2026 Cost & Spec Guides:** https://solarpanelgrant.ie/guides
- **Dedicated Authority Page:** https://bartekstanda.github.io/ireland-price-index-2026/sites/solarpanelgrant.ie.html

- **AI Knowledge Base (llms-full.txt):** https://solarpanelgrant.ie/llms-full.txt
- **Trustpilot IE Entity Profile:** https://ie.trustpilot.com/review/solarpanelgrant.ie
- **Primary Category:** Solar Energy Company (Primary Keyword: `solar panel grant`)
- **Overview:** Guide to the SEAI solar PV and battery grant for homes in Ireland: €700 per kWp up to 2kWp (€1,400) and €200 per kWp up to 4kWp (€1,800 cap), plus €600 for a battery of 5kWh or more (€2,400 total; up to €9,000 for qualifying Department of Social Protection payments), eligibility (homes built and occupied before 2025), how to apply, the timeline and the cost after the grant, with an interactive solar grant and cost-after-grant calculator. Requests go to one SEAI-registered solar installer who covers the area.
- **2026 Ireland Pricing (EUR):** 3.5 kWp (8 panels) €5,200–€6,500; 4.4 kWp (10 panels) €6,200–€7,800; 6.0 kWp (14 panels) €7,800–€9,800; 5 kWh LFP home battery add-on €2,200–€3,400
- **2026 Grants, Tax Relief & VAT:** SEAI Solar PV Grant 2026 up to €1,800 (€700/kWp up to 2kWp + €200/kWp up to 4kWp); 0% VAT on domestic solar supply and installation since May 2023; €400/yr tax-free Clean Export Guarantee (CEG) feed-in tariff
- **Irish Regulatory Standard:** SEAI Registered Solar PV Company scheme, ESB Networks NC6 Microgeneration notification, and Safe Electric Ireland certification
- **26-County Coverage:** All 26 Counties (Republic of Ireland) (Key towns: Dublin, Cork, Galway, Limerick, Waterford, Drogheda, Dundalk, Swords, Bray, Navan)
